words.definition: adj. 孤独的；偏僻的；唯一的

examples.en: He led a solitary life in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他在山里过着离群索居的生活。

examples.en: A solitary tree stood on the bare hilltop.
examples.zh: 光秃秃的山顶上孤零零立着一棵树。

words.usage: 形容人孤独、地点偏僻或事物仅有一个：a solitary life 独居生活、a solitary exception 唯一的例外、solitary confinement 单独监禁。派生：solitude n. 孤独。
collocations: a solitary life 独居生活
a solitary exception 唯一的例外
words.mnemonic: sol 单独加 itary，独自一人。

words.definition: adv. 在楼下 adj. 楼下的

examples.en: She went downstairs to answer the door.
examples.zh: 她下楼去开门。

examples.en: The downstairs tenant complained about the noise.
examples.zh: 楼下的租客抱怨噪音太大。

words.usage: 副词表方向或位置，前面不加介词：go downstairs 下楼，不说 go to downstairs。对应词 upstairs。作定语时为形容词：the downstairs bathroom 楼下浴室。
collocations: the downstairs bathroom 楼下浴室
words.mnemonic: down 下加 stairs 楼梯，沿梯而下。

words.definition: n. 盒式磁带；暗盒

examples.en: She found an old cassette of her favorite band.
examples.zh: 她找到一盘挚爱乐队的旧磁带。

examples.en: The interview was recorded on a cassette.
examples.zh: 那次采访录在磁带里。

words.usage: 指装磁带或胶卷的盒式装置，录音机时代的核心词：a cassette player 磁带播放机、a cassette tape 一盘磁带。如今多见于怀旧与复古语境。
collocations: a cassette player 磁带播放机
a cassette tape 一盘磁带
words.mnemonic: casse 盒加 ette 小，装磁带的小盒。

words.definition: n. 神职人员（总称）

examples.en: The clergy played a key role in medieval society.
examples.zh: 神职人员在中世纪社会中举足轻重。

examples.en: Members of the clergy were exempt from military service.
examples.zh: 神职人员免服兵役。

words.usage: 集合名词，统称神职人员，谓语可单可复；个体称 clergyman 或 clergywoman。搭配 the clergy and the laity 教牧与平信徒。派生：clerical adj. 文书的。
collocations: the clergy and the laity 教牧与平信徒
a member of the clergy 一名神职人员
clergy and nobles 教士与贵族
words.mnemonic: cler 教士加 gy，教士的群体。

words.definition: n. 垫子；缓冲 v. 缓冲；减轻

examples.en: She put a cushion behind her back.
examples.zh: 她在背后垫了个靠垫。

examples.en: Savings can cushion the shock of losing a job.
examples.zh: 积蓄能减轻失业带来的冲击。

words.usage: 名词坐垫、靠垫，动词表缓冲、减轻冲击：cushion the blow 减轻打击、cushion the effects of inflation 缓冲通胀影响。经济语境常说风险缓冲。

confusables.note: 激情，双 s 同尾音

collocations: a cushion against risk 风险缓冲
cushion the impact 缓冲影响
words.mnemonic: 谐音「苦身」，垫子护身免受苦。

words.definition: n. 蚊子

examples.en: A mosquito bit him on the ankle.
examples.zh: 一只蚊子叮了他的脚踝。

examples.en: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
examples.zh: 蚊子在死水中繁殖。

words.usage: 复数双写 o 作 mosquitoes。搭配 a mosquito net 蚊帐、mosquito bites 蚊虫叮咬、mosquito-borne diseases 蚊媒疾病，公共卫生阅读高频。西语借词。
words.mnemonic: 西语借词本义小苍蝇，小身大扰。

words.definition: n. 鸽子；鸽派人物

examples.en: A white dove is a universal symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 白鸽是普世的和平象征。

examples.en: The doves in the cabinet argued for negotiation.
examples.zh: 内阁中的主和派主张谈判。

words.usage: 文学化指鸽子，日常口语多说 pigeon。政治术语 dove 鸽派、主和派人物，与 hawk 鹰派相对。注意 dive 的过去式 dove 同形而读音不同。
collocations: a dove of peace 和平鸽
doves and hawks 鸽派与鹰派
words.mnemonic: d 加 ove 爱，爱之鸟即和平鸽。

words.definition: n. 手推车；（英）无轨电车

examples.en: She pushed a trolley down the supermarket aisle.
examples.zh: 她推着购物车走过超市过道。

examples.en: The old trolley still runs along the coast.
examples.zh: 那辆老式电车仍沿海岸线行驶。

words.usage: 英式指购物手推车与电车；美式购物车说 cart，trolley 多指有轨电车。搭配 a shopping trolley 购物车、a luggage trolley 行李车、a trolley bus 无轨电车。
collocations: a luggage trolley 行李推车
a trolley bus 无轨电车
words.mnemonic: troll 推车小人加 ey，小推车。

words.definition: n. 橱柜；食橱

examples.en: The plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 盘子放在厨房橱柜里。

examples.en: She keeps her medicine in the bathroom cupboard.
examples.zh: 她把药放在浴室柜里。

words.usage: 发音特殊，字母 p 常弱化。搭配 a kitchen cupboard 厨房橱柜、cupboard space 储物空间。习语 a skeleton in the cupboard 家丑，美式说 closet。
collocations: a kitchen cupboard 厨房橱柜
a skeleton in the cupboard 家丑
words.mnemonic: cup 杯加 board 板，放杯子的板柜。

words.definition: adj. 冒犯的；进攻的 n. 攻势

examples.en: His jokes were offensive to many listeners.
examples.zh: 他的笑话冒犯了许多听众。

examples.en: The army launched a major offensive at dawn.
examples.zh: 拂晓时分，军队发动了大规模攻势。

words.usage: 形容词两义：冒犯的、无礼的，反义 inoffensive；进攻的，反义 defensive。名词指军事或舆论攻势：launch an offensive 发动攻势、take the offensive 采取主动。
collocations: launch an offensive 发动攻势
take the offensive 采取攻势
words.mnemonic: of 加 fense 打加 ive，打人的即冒犯。

words.definition: n. 矛；梭镖 vt. 用矛刺

examples.en: The warriors hurled spears at their enemies.
examples.zh: 武士们向敌人投掷长矛。

examples.en: He used a spear to catch fish in the shallows.
examples.zh: 他在浅滩用鱼叉捕鱼。

words.usage: 古代长柄武器：hurl a spear 掷矛。比喻义集中在复合词 spearhead，名词矛头、动词带头：spearhead a campaign 领导运动。spear fishing 鱼叉捕鱼。
collocations: spearhead a campaign 领导运动
words.mnemonic: pear 梨插上棍，梨形矛尖。

words.definition: n. 小木屋；船舱；机舱

examples.en: They stayed in a log cabin by the lake.
examples.zh: 他们住在湖边的一间原木小屋里。

examples.en: The cabin crew checked the plane before takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飞前，机组人员检查了飞机。

words.usage: 指小木屋或船舱、机舱：a log cabin 原木小屋、cabin crew 机组人员、a first-class cabin 头等舱。习语 cabin fever 长期幽居的烦躁不安。
collocations: a log cabin 原木小屋
words.mnemonic: cab 车厢加 in，小小的舱屋。

words.definition: n. 同志；战友

examples.en: He fought alongside his comrades in the war.
examples.zh: 战争中，他与战友们并肩作战。

examples.en: Old comrades gathered to share memories.
examples.zh: 老战友们重聚，共话当年。

words.usage: 指共同奋斗的亲密伙伴，革命语境色彩浓，如今也可幽默地称呼同伴。派生：comradeship n. 同志情谊、comradely adj. 亲如同志的。搭配 comrades-in-arms 战友。
collocations: a trusted comrade 可靠的同志
words.mnemonic: com 共同加 rade，共同闯荡的人。

words.definition: n. 经纪人，中间人；vt. 促成，斡旋（协议等）

examples.en: The insurance broker persuaded him to switch to a cheaper policy.
examples.zh: 保险经纪人劝他换成更便宜的保单。

examples.en: UN officials tried to broker a ceasefire between the two sides.
examples.zh: 联合国官员试图在双方之间促成停火。

words.usage: 常指保险、证券经纪人；作动词表「促成、斡旋」，如 broker a deal 促成交易、broker a ceasefire 斡旋停火。派生：brokerage n. 经纪业，佣金。

synonyms.note: 代理人，通用；broker 专金融撮合

collocations: broker a deal 促成交易
power broker 幕后权势人物
words.mnemonic: 谐音「不老客」：跑熟门路的老客撮合买卖 → 经纪人

words.definition: n. 果园；（宅旁）果树林

examples.en: The orchard yields apples worth thousands of pounds each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天这片果园产出价值数千英镑的苹果。

examples.en: They planted an orchard on the hillside to slow soil erosion.
examples.zh: 他们在山坡上开辟果园以减缓水土流失。

words.usage: 可数名词，指成片种植果树的园地，常以「水果名＋orchard」构成搭配，如 apple orchard 苹果园、cherry orchard 樱桃园。契诃夫名剧《樱桃园》英文即 The Cherry Orchard。
words.mnemonic: or+chard(园)：orchid 是兰花，orchard 是果园

words.definition: n. 拿起，取走；（经济、销售的）回升；皮卡货车

examples.en: Economists noted a modest pickup in consumer spending last quarter.
examples.zh: 经济学家注意到上季度消费支出温和回升。

examples.en: He loaded the tools onto his pickup and drove to the farm.
examples.zh: 他把工具装上皮卡车，开去了农场。

words.usage: 由短语动词 pick up 名词化而来，多义需按语境判断：pickup truck 皮卡车；a pickup in demand 需求回升；pickup point 取货点。经济类阅读常考「回升」一义。
collocations: a pickup in demand 需求回升
words.mnemonic: pick up「捡起、取」名词化 → 取货、皮卡、回升

words.definition: n. 钟摆；摇摆不定的事态（舆论、潮流等）

examples.en: The pendulum of public opinion has swung back toward reform.
examples.zh: 舆论的风向已摆回到改革一边。

examples.en: In physics class we measured the period of a simple pendulum.
examples.zh: 物理课上我们测量了单摆的周期。

words.usage: 本义钟摆，考研阅读常考引申义「舆论或潮流的摇摆」，the pendulum swings back 风向回摆；swing of the pendulum 钟摆式的反复。物理语境指单摆、摆锤。
collocations: the pendulum swings 风向逆转
swing of the pendulum 钟摆式摆动
words.mnemonic: pend(悬挂)+ulum → 挂着来回摆 → 钟摆；引申摇摆

words.definition: n. 新娘；（古语）姑娘

examples.en: The bride wore a white gown designed by a Parisian studio.
examples.zh: 新娘穿着一家巴黎工作室设计的白色婚纱。

examples.en: According to custom, the bride and groom exchanged rings.
examples.zh: 按照习俗，新娘与新郎交换了戒指。

words.usage: 高频搭配 bride and groom 新娘新郎；习语 take sb as one's bride 娶某人为妻。派生：bridal adj. 婚礼的；bridesmaid n. 伴娘。
collocations: bride and groom 新娘新郎
words.mnemonic: b+ride：骑马迎娶 → 新娘；别混 bribe 贿赂

words.definition: adj. 令人愉快的；和蔼友善的；（天气）宜人的

examples.en: The hotel offers pleasant rooms at reasonable prices.
examples.zh: 这家酒店以合理的价格提供舒适的客房。

examples.en: It is pleasant to walk along the river on a summer evening.
examples.zh: 夏日傍晚沿河散步令人惬意。

words.usage: 常用句型 It is pleasant to do sth 做某事令人愉快；多修饰天气、旅程、性格等。派生：please v. 使高兴；pleasure n. 愉快；pleasantly adv. 愉快地。
words.mnemonic: pleas(=please 高兴)+ant → 令人高兴的

words.definition: adj. 狂怒的；猛烈的，激烈的

examples.en: Passengers were furious at the airline's repeated delays.
examples.zh: 乘客们对航空公司一再延误大为光火。

examples.en: A furious debate broke out over the new tax policy.
examples.zh: 围绕新税收政策爆发了激烈的争论。

words.usage: 表「狂怒」用 be furious with sb、be furious at sth；表「猛烈」可修饰 storm、debate、pace 等名词。派生：fury n. 狂怒；furiously adv. 猛烈地。
collocations: be furious at the delay 对延误暴怒
a furious storm 猛烈风暴
words.mnemonic: fury(狂怒)+ious(充满) → 狂怒的；风暴般猛烈
